Highly recommend! We had a great experience getting our new patio done in Frisco. From day one, Homestop made the whole process feel easy — super responsive, patient with our design changes, and full of helpful suggestions. We looked at everything from wood to composite materials, and they had a ton of styles and finishes to explore.

You can tell they’ve been doing this a long time — the project was well-managed, stayed on schedule, and the final result was exactly what we’d hoped for. No upsel

I give 5 stars to Jay, Erick and Danielo who worked directly on my project. There was a small issue that needed fixed and these guys were professional, friendly and hardworking. They fixed it without question and went above and beyond. Workers like this are very hard to find these days and they are why this company is getting a 5 star review and any business owner should be proud to have hard working individuals like this on their team. Thanks again guys, you rock!

Home Stop coated my 2-car and 3-car garage floors 7-years ago and they still look great.  So I just hired them to coat my three daughters 2-car garages (2 in Dallas and 1 in Fort Worth). They delivered in spades!  Two of the slabs had significant cracks and an old coating that was flaking up in chunks.  Home Stop grinded the slabs and filled the cracks with a poly material that’s flexible and will move with the slab to protect against future cracking.  Then applied the base coat, custom colored

HomeStop Inc. did a fantastic job on our new patio cover! From start to finish, the experience was smooth and professional. Greg helped us design exactly what we wanted and made the process easy, and Luis did an excellent job with the installation — precise, clean, and efficient. The patio looks amazing and really upgraded our outdoor space. Highly recommend HomeStop for quality work and great service!

Quality of work was a 5 Star!
Lack of communication was a major issue.  Project that should have been started within 30 days of signing, June of 2025.  Finally finished the week of November 10, 2025.  Communication and Customer Service are key to me, we got none of that.  I wished I had read more reviews, as I would not have gone with this company.

Subcontractors beware. We were hired by this company/homestop to do several projects. I raised concerns on various of the projects due to lack of details and communication. Funny how clients didn't know we were going to show up or hadn't even seen drawings and we were already showing up to start work. A lot of the frustrations were from improper practices from pouring concrete on top of irrigation lines with less than a minimum coverage resulting in early cracking sped up by the heat and us bein

Absolutely love our new patio cover! It transformed our backyard into a cool, shaded retreat — perfect for Texas summers. The team was professional, on time, and paid great attention to detail. Worth every penny!”

We are very pleased with the new garage floor.   Jay and Joseph worked very hard to remove the old epoxy to well prepare the surface.  It was tougher to remove then they expected, but they maintained a positive attitude and just pushed through to get it ready to apply new floor.  Since rain was expected the next day, a two-day job turned into a one-day job.  They worked late into the evening to get it done so that it would be dry before the rain.   Excellent job by all!

Absolutely fantastic company to work with. The quality of the work i can not be anymore impressed with. The guys really listened to what I wanted and delivered. Thank all very much. I would totally recommend to everyone and have.

Took almost 6 months to complete because of order problems and delays. Then substituted quoted materials for builder grade. Installer was good, salesman not so much. I would look elsewhere for your needs.

The HomeStop crew arrived on time, worked steadily and professionally all day! They completed our garage project the same day and I couldn't be happier with the results. I would recommend HomeStop to anyone looking to upgrade their garage floor.

I am providing this review to inform the reader of two things. First the disgruntled service I received from Homestop and secondly to prevent any potential buyer from having to deal with the issues I had to go through. I signed a contract for 2 applications.An MVB flake epoxy in the garage and a cool patio Hennacooldeck installation.
To start i was told they would start on a Friday between noon and 2PM. I reached out to HomeStop at 2:30PM that day and they said that the installer was coming from
They did my garage floor Polyaspartic coating. They were so awesome. Very professional from start to finish. Their installers were very thorough and did a great job.

Eliana was good, she explained their product and the difference between polyurea versus epoxy. Their product is a little more than epoxy but the quality is incredibly better.  She was very responsive to communcation.

Erik and Danilo were great. They arrived early and explained the process. Also kept in touch through out the day with updates. Cleaned up their mess. Very satisfied with their work. Definitely would recommend.

What a wonderful job they did staining our front porch and outside grilling area. We will definitely be using you guys again in the nearest future.

Great price as well. Thank you guys!

Do not use this company! They will sell you a job, collect your money and try to never respond after. Jeff was our sales rep and never would answer after the money was collected. VP Michael made agreements he did not keep and also avoided answering phone calls or returning emails. This company is a joke. Take your time and find a company that is reliable and honest.
Homestop did an amazing job with my attic insulation. They communicated throughout the whole process, and even helped with a rodent problem I was unaware of! 10 out of 10!!! Highly recommend!
Amazing job by Team HomeStop. My garage floors look great. I highly recommend if you want nice looking floors, easy to clean, and be worth the cost.

Outstanding!!  Working with Homestop has been a refreshing experience & we highly recommend them!!  Working with Larry in sales & Mike who does installation was a very pleasant, professional experience!  Thank you!!
Great job! Professional crew, cleaned everything up, did a great job informing me of use and care. Garage looks clean and fresh!
I am very pleased with the quality of work done on my sidewalk. Communication on scheduling the work around weather delays was excellent.
Started work on my property and never finished the job. They keep saying they will come back tomorrow and now i can not get a hold of anybody. It has been 2 weeks. Please be aware and stay away.
Great job. Great Communication. Great Price. If you are on the fence…. Just go for it… Hire them and you will love it!
I’m very happy with the work. Garage looks amazing. Very professional crew and the owner are very friendly.
Everything went very smooth, quickly, and professionally.  Results look great. Thanks for everything
Very pleased with my patio cover. Installer Mike did an awesome job. Thank You
This Project started out as a nightmare but thank you Amanda for always taking my call and listening to me complain you have a wonderful Employee with great customer service skills
The guys were great and did a wonderful job
Great work on a garage floor.
